These structures are adorned with bright lights, predominantly white and orange, which create a striking contrast against the dark background. The camera pans slowly from left to right, revealing more of these glowing objects as they appear to be moving or floating in a vast, dark space. caption: A dark stage lighting rig fills a side-by-side stereo fisheye view, its left and right halves appearing symmetrical across a near-black gap. Overhead trusses carry bright white LED strips and rows of round orange dots, while a diagonal arm of orange dots hangs from each top corner. Across the early frames these orange dots brighten and the corner arms become more fully visible, extending inward, as the small outlined fixture clusters low in each half remain lit in place. Volumetric white beams then emerge from the upper moving-head fixtures, angling downward and inward. The beams intensify until they cross near the center in an X, and a crowd of tiny white human silhouettes along the bottom edge becomes progressively lit. The sequence keeps its bilateral symmetry throughout.
